phase_0.boundary_condition: One source-bound resident register carries catalyst labels, factor/product support, carry state, banks, and return ancestry; closure requires a proper divisor and exact product boundary.

⊢.justification: Preparation receives N alone; no factors enter the carrier.

⊣.justification: The nested boundary contains the source-bound computation.

≻.justification: The order map transforms matching product-support coordinates in place.

≺.chosen_element: inverse bijection on the same support
≺.justification: The inverse map checks exact recovery on the same resident.

⋈.justification: The relation stays attached through resident transitions.

⊙.justification: Catalyst coordinates and source are bound to shared support.

∈.justification: The fork preserves coordinate identity and bank ancestry.

∋.justification: The join restores support through retained ancestry.

⊤.justification: Affirmed readings remain visible per coordinate.

⊥.justification: Refuted readings remain visible per coordinate.

⊞.justification: Contradictory readings remain together as B.

⊡.justification: The final ⊡ fixes the returned value for readout.

phase_2.split_input: source-bound resident support with catalyst map, product/carry constraints, alternatives, and banks
split_outputs: T/F catalyst observations paired with original resident coordinates
unchanged source-bound factor/product support and bank ancestry
phase_2.fuse_result: source-bound resident support with catalyst map, product/carry constraints, alternatives, and banks
phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.true_description: Catalyst-order relation is observed on resident product support.
phase_3.false_description: The inverse or support-preservation relation is refuted on a retained coordinate.
phase_3.both_description: Both readings occur on retained branches and remain resident together.

steps.domain_action: establish the first enclosing carrier boundary
bind catalyst order to the source resident
fork the first coordinate family with ancestry
fork the second coordinate family with ancestry
apply catalyst-order map to resident product support
apply inverse catalyst-order map on that resident
retain coordinates whose relation is refuted
join first fork through retained ancestry
join enclosing fork through retained ancestry
fix returned value for terminal readout

phase_5.compiler_frontend: Vox GFE resident-support transformer compiled into the G-mOMonadOS prepared membrane
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: shared resident-register lanes carry catalyst labels and matching product/carry support
phase_5.memory_mechanism: banked re-entry state retains branches, source binding, and inverse-map witness
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: apply catalyst map and inverse within the same per-coordinate resident traversal
phase_5.alfs_store: resident support and exact boundary witness store selected transformed coordinates with ancestry

phase_6.cycle_cost: per-coordinate bijection and inverse over the current resident support
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: source-bound support, banks, and catalyst-label order
phase_6.post_cycle_state: same support recovered with transformed-order observations retained
